t024: Probes models whose names contain free or whose metadata reports zero price without deprecation. Tries the anonymous lane first, then a Zen key; a model is disabled only on an explicit not-found signal and rechecked after 24 hours. Transient errors never create a new disable: enabled models retry after 1 hour, disabled ones keep their original reason and retry after 24 hours. A restored or manual model stays enabled and skips automatic probing; switching back to automatic schedules a probe on the next pass. System One uses a dedicated 1+1 decision question. With auto effort, the highest probed level is shown.
